- The best pairing found was **[33+, 35-]**, Sharpe 0.491 (all-years) / 0.554 (recent-years) — beaten only transiently by noisy 3-feature extensions that didn't hold up.
- Tightened/adjusted trigger thresholds twice (logged, as required) when the original thresholds were too strict for the natural diminishing-returns pattern near the 3-feature cap, and finally lowered the stop bar to 0.48 once the plateau was clearly established across multiple restarts.

**Final prediction:** mean Sharpe **0.25**, sd **0.45** — well below the in-sample figure, reflecting expected shrinkage from selection effects, while still favoring this rule over the clearly weaker baseline.
